key_patterns:
Horizon composes sections in JSON templates from nested block trees. To ADD a homepage section, copy the block structure of a section's `presets` entry (found inside the `{% schema %}` of sections/collection-list.liquid, sections/media-with-content.liquid, etc.) into templates/index.json's `sections` map with a unique id, then add that id to the top-level `order` array. Settings reference palette tokens as the literal strings `{{ settings.color_palette.background }}` / `.foreground` / `.color1` / `.color2`, and fonts as `var(--font-heading--family)` (Jost) / `var(--font-body--family)` (Inter). Terracotta #BC8A5A is a literal accent (not in the 4-color palette). Text blocks carry html like `

...

` or `

...

` with per-block font/case/size settings; small eyebrows use uppercase + letter-spacing. media-with-content uses static `_media-without-appearance` + `_content-without-appearance` blocks containing text/group/button child blocks. collection-list uses a static `_collection-card` + a `collection_list` picker setting (leave empty for a merchant-editable placeholder). featured-blog-posts binds a `blog` setting and renders empty placeholders when blank. The generic `section` section is a flexible centered container accepting text/button/image/divider child blocks — use it for Brand Statement and Final CTA.
